# RVE Remotion Templates (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/reactvideoeditor/remotion-templates @ 6209b72
License: MIT (stated in the upstream README: "All templates in this repository are available under
the MIT License"). Created by the team at https://www.reactvideoeditor.com.

81 self-contained Remotion components (text effects, transitions, photo treatments, charts).
They are kept here as a reference library for building new scenes; they are not compiled into
the video (see tsconfig.json "include"). Patterns adapted from them: polaroid frames, photo
stacks, film burn / light leak overlays, camera shake, whip pan, text highlight.
